about_the_game:
High-speed single-button platformer where precise timing is key. Switch gravity through twisted levels that will put your reflexes to the test. Includes single player story mode and competitive local multiplayer for up to 8 players. Easily create your own levels (publishing available in the full version).

This demo includes:

  • Single-player story mode up to the start of Level 3

  • 3 official multiplayer stages

  • 2 community-made single player levels

  • 2 community-made multiplayer stages

  • Full level editor (local saves only, online publishing in the full version)

  • Full gamepad support

  • Steam login can optionally be used to save progress on our servers, which will carry over to the full version
